literal: Of the capacity fully having known let one give; that wealth having preserved maintaining way.
translation: Give to others only after fully knowing the measure of your own capacity. That is the true way to preserve and maintain your wealth.
modern: ஒருவன் தன் செல்வத்தின் அளவை முழுமையாக அறிந்து அதற்கேற்ப மற்றவர்களுக்குக் கொடுக்க வேண்டும். அதுவே அவனது செல்வத்தைப் பாதுகாத்து வாழும் வழியாகும்.
explanation: This couplet advises giving to others only within one's means. The word 'ஆற்றின்' refers to the measure of one's capacity or wealth, which must be fully understood ('அற அறிந்து') before giving ('ஈக'). Doing so is described as the true path ('நெறி') to safeguard ('போற்றி') and sustain one's wealth, preventing ruin through over-generosity.
